title: Mehran Gul：中国AI创新被低估，中美差距比想象更小
speaker: Mehran Gul

segments.en: If anything, what has happened in the past couple of days only highlights how important it's hardware is to international affairs. What does it mean for China?
segments.zh: 如果说有什么变化，过去几天发生的事只是凸显了硬件在国际事务中的重要性。这对中国意味着什么？

segments.en: I mean, you've been writing extensively in your book the geographies of innovation about how quickly Chinese AI hyper sailors, how these developers are scaling up, not just what it comes to the adoption of these AI models,
segments.zh: 你在书中广泛讨论了创新的地理分布，谈到中国AI企业如何快速扩张，不仅是在采用这些AI模型方面，

segments.en: but also in terms of innovation. You've been speaking to a lot of these insiders in China.
segments.zh: 而且在创新方面也是如此。你与许多中国业内人士交流过。

segments.en: How close is this race right now between the two?
segments.zh: 目前两者之间的竞赛有多接近？

segments.en: I think much closer than people imagine it to be.
segments.zh: 我认为比人们想象的要接近得多。

segments.en: I think something that one of your speakers mentioned earlier that the US is very good at creating, at inventing new things, where as China is very good at diffusing it,
segments.zh: 之前一位发言者提到，美国非常擅长创造和发明新事物，而中国非常擅长推广传播，

segments.en: or the US is really good at going from zero to one China is going from one to one hundred.
segments.zh: 或者说美国擅长从零到一，中国擅长从一到一百。

segments.en: You know, these are mimetic frames that you probably would have heard about very frequently, which I think at this point are quite obsolete.
segments.zh: 这些是你可能经常听到的模仿论调，我认为现在已经相当过时了。

segments.en: When it comes to AI, China is right up there with the US in making frontier innovations.
segments.zh: 在AI领域，中国在前沿创新方面与美国并驾齐驱。

segments.en: It's just a fact that today the most cited paper in all of our artificial intelligence, a paper called the ResNet paper, was authored in Beijing, not at Stanford, not at Harvard, not at MIT.
segments.zh: 事实是，如今人工智能领域被引用最多的论文——ResNet论文，出自北京，而非斯坦福、哈佛或麻省理工。

segments.en: The ResNet papers, four co-authors, all received their undergraduate graduate and PhD degrees in China, and they had never left China before writing what is essentially the most important paper in AI.
segments.zh: ResNet论文的四位合著者，本科、研究生和博士都在中国完成，在写出这篇堪称AI领域最重要的论文之前，他们从未离开过中国。

segments.en: If you look at the top 100 paper, most cited papers in artificial intelligence, 41 of them have Chinese co-authors.
segments.zh: 如果看人工智能领域被引用最多的100篇论文，其中41篇有中国合著者。

segments.en: So it's, I think the competition is much tighter than people often portray it to be.
segments.zh: 所以我认为，竞争比人们通常描绘的要激烈得多。

segments.en: It is not true that China only scales, I think China invents plenty as well,
segments.zh: 中国并非只做规模扩张，我认为中国也有很多发明创造。
